findings.title: Dev mode serializes all GetWebAssets calls behind an exclusive lock
findings.body: When cfg.Env == setting.Dev the cache is intentionally bypassed, but the new code still acquires entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock() (an exclusive write lock) around the entire manifest read, including file I/O and JSON decoding. Every request that touches web assets in a dev environment is now fully serialized, and if a future change re-enables the CDN path (the commented-out cdn variable) this would also serialize a blocking HTTP call. The lock only needs to be held while assigning entryPointAssetsCache; the read/parse could happen outside the lock (e.g., compute first, then lock and store), avoiding the convoy entirely.
